name: Docker Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Docker container configurations and deployments. Covers Docker daemon configuration, container isolation, privilege escalation, namespace and cgroup security, volume mounts, networking, and container escape techniques.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Docker security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Docker architecture, container isolation mechanisms, and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain Docker images, containers, namespaces, and cgroups
Understands the Docker daemon attack surface and privilege model
Familiar with common container misconfiguration patterns

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Docker configurations under supervision using established tools and checklists
evidence: Runs Docker security scanning tools (e.g., Docker Bench, Trivy) under guidance
Identifies privileged containers and dangerous capability grants using checklists
Documents Docker security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Docker security posture and identifies container escape paths
evidence: Independently reviews Docker daemon configuration and container runtime settings
Identifies container escape vectors through misconfigurations (privileged mode, host mounts, capabilities)
Evaluates Docker networking configurations for isolation weaknesses
Produces compliant Docker security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex Docker security scenarios; develops container escape exploits; mentors others
evidence: Develops and executes container escape exploits for various misconfiguration scenarios
Assesses custom Docker runtimes and OCI-compliant alternatives
Reviews Docker assessment work of junior analysts
Contributes to lab container security assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Docker assessment methodology; publishes container security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Docker security assessment framework
Published research on novel container escape techniques or kernel exploitation
Trains teams on advanced Docker security assessment
Recognized as authority on container runtime security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured Docker environment and demonstrate container escape from multiple starting positions
Observe Docker security review during a live engagement, evaluating methodology and thoroughness
